{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lectures''' were a series of holographic lectures recorded and distributed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Ministry of Education]]. The lectures covered military and governmental issues and were distributed to mid-ranking political and military leaders. There were at least five hundred twenty-two lectures. Notable lectures from the series included [[Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture 137/Legends|Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture 137: Combat Starfighters]], [[Alliance Maintenance Lecture 139: Battle Maintenance Schedule for an X-wing Starfighter]], and [[Lecture Number 522: Organization of Alliance Command]].
